tts: Why does everyone end up standing at concerts?
Nobody planned it. Nobody wants it. It just happens.
A crowd, all sitting. Everyone can see the stage.
Then one person near the front stands up. They see better, and the person behind them sees nothing.
caps: Then one person near the front

tts: So they stand too. Then the row behind them. Row by row, it ripples back.
Until everyone is standing, and nobody sees any better than when they were all sitting. They're just more tired.
caps: than when they were all sitting.

tts: Each move makes sense on its own. Together, they cancel out. Economists call this an arms race.
You see it when everyone talks louder in a noisy restaurant, or rivals keep outspending each other on ads.
The way out is a shared rule, like everyone agreeing to stay seated.
